summary: All four story checks (make setup, schema-check, check, test) exit 0. Each acceptance criterion is met on evidence I saw. The only gap is that turbo lint, typecheck and test replayed from cache, so those runs were not fresh executions. I found no blocker or high findings.

checks.criterion: Root package.json private, packageManager equals pnpm --version, engines.node 22.x; workspace includes packages/* and apps/*; lockfile committed; turbo defines build, typecheck, lint, test
checks.evidence: package.json:4 has pnpm@12.16.1, which matches 'pnpm v12.16.1' in the make setup output; package.json:6 has "22.x". pnpm-workspace.yaml lists packages/* and apps/*. pnpm-lock.yaml appears in the diff (1726 lines changed). turbo.json defines all four tasks.

checks.criterion: tsconfig.base.json enables strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes; ESLint 9 flat config with typescript-eslint; Vitest; exact versions
checks.evidence: tsconfig.base.json:12-14 enable all three. eslint.config.mjs is a flat config, with eslint 9.39.5 and typescript-eslint 8.72.2. vitest 5.1.0 is pinned. All dependency versions are exact, with no ranges.

checks.criterion: @terraluna/schema exports zod 4 schemas and types for BundleManifest, GateRecord and the validation file, generated from the JSON Schemas by a pinned generator; generated files committed with a do-not-edit header
checks.evidence: zod 4.6.7 and json-schema-to-zod 2.8.1 are pinned. src/generated/bundle-manifest.ts:1-3 carries the 'Do not edit' header, and the Schema and type exports are present. gate-record.ts and validation.ts are committed alongside it.

checks.criterion: make schema regenerates zod too; make schema-check fails on drift in JSON Schema or zod
checks.evidence: Output: 'JSON Schemas match schema.py' and 'zod schemas match packages/schema/json'. Makefile:60-70 runs both checks and exits 1 if either finds drift. I did not trigger drift myself, since modifying files is not allowed.

checks.criterion: Vitest tests written first: every case in cases.json gets its expected verdict from zod; mock manifest.json and validation.json parse
checks.evidence: Vitest: 3 files, 148 tests passed, including 61 in cases.test.ts. Those tests assert the verdict for each case, plus toStrictEqual on accepted values. mock-bundle.test.ts has 2 tests. The pytest suite passed 404. The turbo test run was a cache hit, so it replayed a prior run.

checks.criterion: Makefile targets setup-ts, check-ts, test-ts; setup, check and test include them
checks.evidence: Makefile:22-24 and 43-55 wire the targets as required. setup-ts checks for Node 22.* and runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. make setup printed Node 22.23.3 and succeeded. make check ran ruff, mypy, and turbo lint and typecheck, all passing (the turbo tasks were cache hits).

checks.criterion: commitlint and husky setup keeps working
checks.evidence: package.json keeps "prepare": "husky" and the pinned @commitlint/cli, @commitlint/config-conventional (21.2.4) and husky 9.1.7. .husky/commit-msg exists. The install ran with --frozen-lockfile.

checks.criterion: Scope: only files in the story's list changed
checks.evidence: All 20 changed files fall under the package.json, pnpm-*, turbo.json, tsconfig.base.json, eslint.config.mjs, packages/schema/* and Makefile entries in the story's files list. The working tree is clean except for logs/.

findings.claim: The turbo lint, typecheck and test results I saw were cache hits, not fresh executions.
findings.evidence: 'cache hit, replaying logs' and 'FULL TURBO' in the output. The replayed logs show the checks passing, and the pytest portion ran fresh.

resolution.reason: A Turborepo cache hit is a content-addressed replay of a run with identical inputs, not a skipped check. `turbo run lint typecheck test --dry=json` shows each task hash covers every package file (json/, scripts/, src/, src/generated/, tests/), the test task also covers ../../fixtures/mock-bundle/ and ../../fixtures/schema-cases/, and the global hash covers tsconfig.base.json, eslint.config.mjs and the locked external dependencies. Fresh evidence at the round-1 fix head (c27dd95): `TURBO_FORCE=true make check-ts test-ts` exited 0, printing "cache bypass, force executing" for lint, typecheck and test, "Cached: 0 cached, 2 total" and "Cached: 0 cached, 1 total", and Vitest "Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 157 passed (157)". The implement entry also recorded a forced run with 0 cached. Turborepo caching is the PRD 8.2 toolchain choice, so the Makefile keeps it.
